description_en: Searches the code repository for data using the search criteria
description_zh: 根据查询条件搜索代码仓库数据
name: ListSearchRepository

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can obtain it from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the repository creator. You can filter by only one account ID
parameters.help_zh: 创建人的阿里云账号ID，仅支持单人筛选
parameters.name: aliyun_pk

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the repository.

- `0`: private

- `10`: internal
parameters.help_zh:
代码库的可见性
- 0：私有
- 10：企业可见
parameters.name: visibility_level

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid range: 1–100. Default: `20`
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. The default value is `desc`.

- `desc`: descending

- `asc`: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认为desc
- desc：降序
- asc：升序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. The default value is `default`.

- `default`: best match

- `created_at`: Creation time

- `updated_at`: Update time

- `star`: Number of stars

- `like`: Number of likes

- `comment`: Number of comments

- `reply`: Number of replies
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为default
- default：默认排序，即综合排序
- created_at：创建时间
- updated_at：更新时间
- star：收藏数
- like：点赞数
- comment：评论数
- reply：回复数
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. The default value is `all`.

- `all`: All public repositories and all private repositories to which you have access.

- `mine`: Repositories where you are a member with read access
parameters.help_zh:
搜索范围，默认为all
- all：全局范围，公开库以及有权限的private库
- mine：只作为库或组成员，并且有读权限
parameters.name: scope

fields.help_en:
The full path of the repository, for example, `organization/group/repo`.

> Separate multiple repository paths with a comma (,)
fields.help_zh:
代码库的全路径，例如：organization/group/repo
> 若有多个代码库全路径，使用英文逗号","隔开
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The operator type.

- `equal`: equal

- `unequal`: unequal

- `and`: and

- `or`: or

- `not`: not
fields.help_zh:
查询条件类型
- equal：等于
- unequal：不等于
- and：与
- or：或
- not：非
fields.name: operator_type

fields.help_en:
The match type.

- `term`: exact match

- `regex`: regex match

- `phrase`: phrase match (default)

- `wildcard`: wildcard match
fields.help_zh:
查询匹配类型
- term：精确匹配
- regex：正则匹配
- phrase：短语匹配，默认方式
- wildcard：模糊匹配
fields.name: match_type
